# Historical development records

This directory preserves pre-release planning, dated verification evidence, and
superseded specifications from source commit
`40be5eb01aeeec59226394eae866f4d5c79078f0`. These are archival engineering records,
not current product documentation or integration requirements.

`inventory.json` records each original path and SHA-256. The snapshots retain
original wording, including obsolete handoffs, development status, and relative
links that were meaningful in their original locations. They are preserved to
interpret historical evidence, not to assign work or describe release behavior.

The publisher README is the original imported document; its checksum remains in
the upstream provenance manifest. The active publisher README is a documented
local documentation override. The image-lock snapshot preserves its historical
status label; the active lock retains the same image identities without that label.

Current product documentation starts at the repository's root README and
`docs/INTEGRATION.md`. No historical record in this directory overrides the active
contract lock, Operator runtime pin, image locks, or source lock.
